class.name: NNHTNArgumentReference
class.brief_description: A computed argument for an [NNHTNSubtaskCall], read from the arguments or the world state.
class.description: Used as a value of [member NNHTNSubtaskCall.argument_bindings]. While planning, the reference reads [member key] from the call's arguments ([constant ARGUMENT]) or from the predicted world state ([constant WORLD_STATE]), then follows [member field_path] through nested dictionaries: [codeblock] var reference := NNHTNArgumentReference.new() reference.source = NNHTNArgumentReference.WORLD_STATE reference.key = "selected_coin" reference.field_path = "target.name" call.argument_bindings["target"] = reference [/codeblock] A missing argument or key, a missing field, a path through a value that is not a [Dictionary], or an invalid configuration reports an error and rejects the branch; it never falls back to [code]null[/code]. A world state key whose value is [code]null[/code] is absent, so it counts as missing; an argument whose value is [code]null[/code] resolves to [code]null[/code]. The [member key] of a [constant WORLD_STATE] reference is a replanning trigger. [member field_path] uses the same syntax as [member NNHTNBinding.entry_field].

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns one message per configuration problem: an invalid [member source], an empty [member key], or a [member field_path] with an empty segment. Empty when the reference is valid. The owning [NNHTNSubtaskCall] shows these as configuration warnings.

members.member: An optional dot-separated path of [Dictionary] keys applied to the value of [member key], such as [code]"target.position"[/code]. Empty reads the value itself. Leading, trailing or doubled dots are invalid.
The argument name or world state key to read. Must not be empty.

Where [member key] is read from: [constant ARGUMENT] reads the call's arguments (inherited, [member NNHTNSubtaskCall.args], and earlier bindings), while [constant WORLD_STATE] reads the predicted world state and registers [member key] as a replanning trigger.

constants.constant: Reads the call's arguments: the inherited ones merged with [member NNHTNSubtaskCall.args], plus any [member NNHTNSubtaskCall.argument_bindings] entries already applied, which come earlier in sorted key order.
Reads the predicted world state at the point the call is planned.
